name: VerveDo
tagline: A clean, minimal to-do list with the latest Material look
description:
VerveDo is a concise, clean to-do app for keeping track of what you need to get done. It follows Google's latest Material 3 Expressive design, so it looks and feels right at home on a modern Android phone.

No clutter, no distractions, just a simple task list built with Jetpack Compose.
